prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective “best” broker for everyone—it depends on whether you need an ACA individual/family plan, Medicare, or small-business coverage. For **individual or family coverage**, I’d start with **BBS Insurance**: it says it compares Marketplace and private plans across carriers, serves both sides of the Kansas–Missouri line, and has offices in North Kansas City and Overland Park. Call **816-205-4664**. [BBS Insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/health-insurance/)

**AIS Health Insurance Advisors** in Overland Park is another option, especially if you want help checking subsidy eligibility and comparing ACA plans; call **913-333-8627**. [AIS Health Advisors](https://aishealthadvisors.com/)

Before enrolling, ask each broker which carriers they represent, whether they’ll check your doctors and prescriptions, and whether they’ll help you review the plan at renewal. Broker help is generally free, but confirm that directly. If you tell me your ZIP code and whether you’re looking for ACA, Medicare, or employer coverage, I can narrow this down.
